text:
Nina (Partnerships): Heads up 1: planning the marketplace onboarding kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure. Two open questions: (1) canonical SKU format across clouds (we've seen varying max lengths/char sets) and (2) data residency disclosures for EU customers. Who can own each?

Kai (Infra): I can own the SKU length/charset mapping. Short summary: AWS allows up to 100 chars for SKU aliases but storefront slugs are tighter; GCP enforces only alphanum and dashes; Azure uses a GUID-like publisher SKU in some flows. Recommend we pick a conservative canonical SKU: lowercase alphanum + dash, max 60 chars.

Jon (DevEx): For terraform and marketplace artifacts we'll need both the canonical SKU and a cloud-specific translation table. I'll maintain a small YAML file in the infra repo that maps canonical -> {aws_sku, gcp_sku, azure_sku} and we can auto-generate the listing bundle. Example YAML snippet: ```yaml
canonical_sku: redwood-inference-pro
aws_sku: redwood-inference-pro-v1
gcp_sku: redwood-inference-pro
azure_sku: redwood-inference-pro-0001
``` 

Sarah (Legal): On residency: marketplaces require an explicit data processing location statement only for certain regulated categories. For EU-targeted listings we should declare that telemetry and billing metadata are stored in EU regions and provide the DPA / subprocessors list. Also need to confirm whether the trial telemetry qualifies as personal data under local laws. I'll prepare wording for the listing copy and the marketplace legal artifact pack.

Leo (SalesOps): Pricing note 1: If we ship a boxed trial SKU, marketplace storefronts often need a separate trial SKU (e.g., SKUs that map to 0-price entitlements). That means two entries per offering: sku_pro and sku_pro_trial. We should decide now so we can sync billing and promo codes. Also, promo codes on GCP marketplace are limited; AWS has coupon flows.

Nina (Partnerships): Good call. Let's default to boxed trial SKU for launch (as Legal suggested) to avoid metering hooks. Kai, can you validate we can attach trial flags to the SKU translation file? Jon can generate a preview package.

Kai (Infra): Confirmed. We'll add a "trial: true" flag in the translation YAML and a metadata field "visibility: trial|public". Ops will make sure the licensing service honors it.

marketplace-bot: New artifact template created: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/templates/multi-cloud-listing-1713001234. Checklist items added: sku-translation, trial-flag, residency-statement, legal-artifact-upload.

Sarah (Legal): Quick product wording suggestion for residency: "By using this listing, telemetry and billing metadata for EU customers are processed within EU regions. See our DPA for details." I'll attach the DPA link in the artifacts.

Jon (DevEx): Two implementation blockers I see: (A) storefront preview requires an icon at 512x512 and (B) the marketplace will reject descriptions containing certain product claims (e.g., "enterprise-grade" needs proof). We'll need marketing to approve the sanitized copy.

Nina (Partnerships): I'll loop in marketing for copy and icons. Action items: Kai owns SKU translation and trial flags (eta Tue), Jon builds preview package (eta Wed), Sarah drafts legal artifact pack (eta Tue EOD), Leo aligns promo/trial SKU mapping with billing (eta Tue). Can we reconvene Wednesday morning for final sign-off?

Kai (Infra): ACK.

Sarah (Legal): ACK.

Jon (DevEx): ACK.

Leo (SalesOps): ACK.

Nina (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll create the ticket and drop the invite for Wed 9:30am.
